CommunityApplications.Profile:
Glovebox is a self-hosted vehicle maintenance tracker: a redesigned fork of [LubeLogger](https://github.com/hargata/lubelog) focused on upcoming service, with a phone-friendly interface and ntfy reminder notifications. It uses the same data format as LubeLogger, so existing installs can switch over by changing only the image.
For bugs and questions, open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/au12/glovebox/issues).
